name: Valentine's Rain
source:
For years, the notorious killer, Valentine, has been stalking the streets, killing indiscriminately and without remorse. Always on the week before Valentine's Day. This year, though, he has even more sinister plans; his masterpiece.

You play 4 different characters: a grizzled cop veteran who lost his family to the serial killer, an intrepid reporter willing to do anything for the next best story, a disgruntled accountant thrown into this unwillingly and a rookie forensic science student with something to prove.

Explore the different options available to you, but be aware: your choices might affect how the game plays out. Will all of the characters make it to the end? Will you find out the truth before it's too late? Will you play into Valentine's sick games?

[From [url=https://dracino.itch.io/valentines-rain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
多年来，臭名昭著的杀手Valentine一直在街头徘徊，冷酷无情地杀人，而且总在情人节前一周下手。今年，他却有了更加险恶的计划：完成自己的杰作。

你将分别扮演四名角色：一位痛失家人的老练警探；一位不惧危险、为了挖到独家新闻不择手段的记者；一位被迫卷入此事、满腹怨气的会计；以及一位急于证明自己的法医专业新生。

探索不同的选择，但请留意，你的决定可能改变游戏进程。所有角色都能活到最后吗？你能及时查明真相吗？你会落入Valentine的疯狂游戏吗？

[来源：[url=https://dracino.itch.io/valentines-rain]Itch.io[/url]]
